servers.name: Invokely Official Statistics MCP
servers.agency: U.S. Census Bureau, Bureau of Labor Statistics, Bureau of Economic Analysis, CDC, U.S. Treasury, Federal Reserve
servers.description: Independent hosted MCP service for source-cited official statistics from U.S. federal data publishers and the Federal Reserve, with additional international official sources. A no-account trial allows 25 calls/day/IP; a no-card Free account includes 500 MCP calls/month. The linked MIT repository is a local adapter only; the hosted backend is separate. REST data queries require Builder, Pro or prepaid credits.
